description: Tripled shrink over 12 weeks. Clear pattern of internal theft correlating with staff shifts, predominantly involving high-value items. Multiple void incidents and inventory discrepancies also observed. Total estimated loss £12,500 over investigation period.
findings: Pattern analysis shows correlation with employee EMP-0001 work schedule. Employee worked all 8 shifts where significant theft occurred. CCTV review confirms removal of items. Void incidents correlate with manager EMP-0006 overrides. Recommended immediate suspension of EMP-0001 pending investigation with police.

description: Regional organized retail crime ring targeting high-value items across 5 Leeds stores over 6 months. Coordinated targeting of specific brands (small appliances, smart home devices). Total estimated regional loss £18,500.
findings: Three distinct organized groups identified targeting appliance departments. External theft professional crew with lookouts. Pattern of hits at peak times.
